Bipolar disorder. Quetiapine is of benefit for the treatment of mania in patients with bipolar disorder (p.372) and the use of atypical antipsychotics in the management of such patients is in- creasing. However, there have been individual case reports of quetiapine-induced mania (see above). In some countries, quetiapine is also licensed for use in the depressive phase of bi- polar disorder.
